items.text: Puka Nacua listed QUESTIONABLE (calf); McVay says he felt lack of power/explosion Thursday, will test pregame. Crucial DFS status.
items.why: Calf injury during Thursday practice; majority participation but stopped
items.implication: GTD; if OUT targets funnel to TEs/WRs like Higbee

items.text: Lamar Jackson QUESTIONABLE (ankle); limited practice all week, trending toward play but GTD per coach.
items.why: Ankle; limited participant, says headed right direction
items.implication: If OUT Huntley starts; Ravens offense downgrade

items.text: Breece Hall QUESTIONABLE (quad); GTD, lean miss but if plays committee possible vs MIA.
items.why: Quad injury
items.implication: If OUT Allen locked RB1 in great matchup; if IN still startable per Berry

items.text: Mike Evans ruled OUT (Achilles/ribs) for Sunday vs ATL; Shanahan confirmed.
items.why: Achilles among ailments; DNP week
items.implication: SF WR corps depleted further; more CMC/Kittle/Kirk funnel

items.text: Davante Adams OUT.
items.why: Hamstring (multi-week)
items.implication: LAR WR depth thin already with Puka Q
items.opportunity: Boosts remaining Rams pass catchers if Puka also out

items.text: Jeremiyah Love OUT; Bam Knight expected lead with Allgeier role.
items.why: Ankle; ruled out
items.implication: ARI RB committee shifts

items.text: David Montgomery OUT (groin).
items.why: Groin; missed prior
items.implication: HOU RB volume to others

items.text: Emeka Egbuka OUT (concussion/foot).
items.why: Concussion protocol + foot
items.implication: TB WR targets redistribute with Mayfield possible return

items.text: Deebo Samuel ruled OUT (hamstring) vs ATL.
items.why: Hamstring; multi-week min
items.implication: Further SF pass-catcher vacuum

items.text: Rashee Rice ruled OUT (hamstring) vs SEA.
items.why: Hamstring/knee; no practice
items.implication: KC WR targets to Worthy/others; Mahomes volume shift

items.text: Loves Saquon (if active vs DAL, efficient prior) and Breece (if plays vs MIA, back in lineup despite Bell worry).
items.why: Matchup + efficiency; return expected
items.implication: Must-start if active

items.text: If Puka Nacua OUT, Stafford hierarchy: 1 Higbee 2 Mumpfield 3 Parkinson 4 Atwell etc.
items.why: Calf GTD; data on remaining targets
items.implication: Higbee TE1 smash if Puka inactive
items.opportunity: TE target share spike to ~37% historical Puka-out

items.text: Bijan Robinson full workload + sweet SF DvP (inflates opp RB 4.4%, 7th most) with Brian Robinson OUT; recent SF RB receptions high.
items.why: BRob OUT + SF concedes RB catches (e.g. 10-68 Harvey)
items.implication: RB1 smash spot
items.opportunity: Full carries + receiving upside vs soft DvP

items.text: George Kittle will go nuts: scheme + entire SF WR corps hurt (Evans/Deebo OUT); ignore National TE Day narrative.
items.why: WR injuries force funnel; CMC slot temptation too
items.implication: TE1 smash + CMC receiving boost

items.text: Puka Nacua listed QUESTIONABLE (calf) for Sunday; will test pregame per McVay. Prior practice limited/missed Friday.
items.why: Calf issue felt during Thursday practice; lack of power/explosion; pregame test.
items.implication: Game-time; if OUT, TE-heavy target tree for Stafford.
items.opportunity: Higbee lead TE share likely rises (prior Puka-out TE share 37%).

items.text: Lamar Jackson QUESTIONABLE (ankle) vs Bengals; limited practice, said headed in right direction.
items.why: Ankle; practicing limited, positive comments.
items.implication: Crucial for Ravens offense and DFS; Huntley if OUT.

items.text: Breece Hall QUESTIONABLE (quad); game-time decision vs Dolphins.
items.why: Quad injury.
items.implication: If active, start; if OUT, Allen elevates to RB1 in good matchup.
items.opportunity: Committee risk if plays; full work for backup if inactive.

items.text: Official OUTs include Mike Evans, Deebo Samuel, Brian Robinson, Emeka Egbuka, Tyler Warren, David Montgomery, Jeremiyah Love, Rashee Rice, Zach Charbonnet, Davante Adams among others.
items.why: Various injuries confirmed Friday/Saturday.
items.implication: Clear inactive; open roles for teammates.
items.opportunity: Snap/target/carry increases for backups and complementary pieces.

items.text: 49ers coach Kyle Shanahan confirmed WR Mike Evans (Achilles) OUT vs Falcons; Deebo also OUT.
items.why: Achilles aggravation.
items.implication: 49ers WR corps decimated; funnel to Kittle/CMC.
items.opportunity: Elevated targets/routes for Kittle; possible CMC slot work.

items.text: LOVE Saquon Barkley if returns vs Cowboys (efficient prior, great matchup); LOVE Breece Hall if active vs Dolphins (start despite some caution).
items.why: Saquon practice return, Dallas soft vs RBs; Breece matchup too good to sit if plays.
items.implication: Must-start if active.
items.conflict: Stephania Bell more cautious on Breece immediate full return.

items.text: If Puka Nacua (calf) can't go, Stafford hierarchy: 1. Tyler Higbee 2. Konata Mumpfield 3. Colby Parkinson 4. Tutu Atwell 5. Jordan Whittington 6. Davis Allen.
items.why: WR injuries (Adams also OUT); historical TE share spike without Puka.
items.implication: Higbee becomes priority TE streamer/start.
items.opportunity: Elevated routes/targets for remaining pass-catchers, especially TEs.

items.text: Colston Loveland BACK and LOVE: since Caleb return, 30% target share, 19.2 PPR/game, 6+ rec and 60+ yards both games.
items.why: Strong usage/stats with Williams back; Kmet IR helps.
items.implication: Strong TE start/stream.

items.text: Brian Robinson OUT (hamstring); 49ers DvP inflates opposing RB by 4.4% (7th-most). Sweet full-workload setup for Bijan Robinson.
items.why: BRob ruled out; recent SF concessions to RBs (White, Holani, Harvey, Love).
items.implication: Bijan bellcow RB1 lock with plus matchup.

items.text: George Kittle will go nuts with entire 49ers WR corps hurt (Evans/Deebo OUT); scheme + talent. CMC tempted for more slot work amid WR injuries (rare buy on RB-as-WR).
items.why: WR injuries force funnel; CMC smiled at slot question.
items.implication: Kittle elite TE1; CMC receiving upside boost.
items.opportunity: Kittle routes/targets spike; CMC possible slot snaps.
items.conflict: Rarely buy RB-as-WR hype but dire situation + Black presence tempts.

items.text: Luther Burden only 68.8% routes but elite 2.56 YPRR. Kmet IR (season-ending knee) may reduce 2/3-TE sets, giving Burden more juice.
items.why: Kmet to IR per coach Johnson; Burden efficiency high.
items.implication: Increased route share/opportunity for Burden.

items.text: TreVeyon Henderson played just 21% of snaps over last three weeks; downgrade signal.
items.why: Snap share collapse recent weeks.
items.implication: Avoid/start sit; role diminished.

items.text: LOVE A.J. Brown (97% routes/33% TS buy despite drops), DeVonta Smith, Tucker Kraft (@DET TE buffet), Jaylen Warren (workload + matchup), Chuba Hubbard, Bucky Irving.
items.why: Usage (AJB routes/TS), matchups (DET pass-catchers, RB-friendly defenses), consistency (Hubbard).
items.implication: Start with confidence.

items.text: HATE Rome Odunze (Gonzalez shadow, outside targets), Josh Downs (low TS/low-scoring), Travis Kelce (tough matchup), Josh Jacobs (workload questions post-layoff @DET).
items.why: Matchup (Odunze/Kelce), role/usage (Downs), layoff uncertainty (Jacobs; ETR notes facility but backups poor).
items.implication: Sit/fade.
items.conflict: Levitan notes Jacobs facility access and weak backups (Lloyd/Johnson EPA poor).
